description: Spec 010 FR-004: extension of configs/phase3/tracker-grid.json for the tuned-turn IMM only, because its best setting there sat on the grid's edge (sigma_ct 0.1 and switch 0.001, both maxima). The grid is widened along those axes and around the other best values; same objective, rows and two-stage method. The EKF's best (sigma_a 0.1) was inside its grid.
